title: The Thornwold Gallows Glade's free 'weigh what this grief asks' text says the surer route is 'the true pardon in Bray's dead-letter box (wits)', implying a direct wits check at the quartermaster's wagon. Actually asking Bray about 'older mail in the box' before finding Fenn in the stockade returns an unrelated item (a sealed letter for Fenmarch) instead; the real 'search the dead-letter box (wits)' option only appears after talking to Fenn and getting his lead. The hint's stated cost/path didn't match what was actually required.
